note: Status vocabularies and the Four Inks Rule (build spec 4.4). Each vocabulary is a different scale from a different source and is never merged with another; the front-end prints the vocabulary label beside every status word. Inks are the Parameter Sky tokens: chalk = exists/neutral, cyan = live now, amber = acts/mode/eye (anything a person did or must do, mode names, pending text, STALE, FIXTURE), fault (red-orange) = only the faulted thing. There is no green: unprobed is never green, and a finished or pass state is chalk with a check glyph.

rules: detected_mode == "transition" and any switching object are amber
a GPU that rests (the mode's rest list) is chalk
a queue count of -1 is chalk text ("queue count not reported: GRID CONTROL reported -1"), never red
STALE and FIXTURE stamps are amber
no grade is a sign-off: every golden grade line carries that sentence
a status word not in its vocabulary is drawn in chalk with the word itself
